header.title: Suppl. Mag. 23: amulet against fever for a woman, with magical characters: AI translation (Claude)
header.author: Supplementum Magicum
header.source: Translated by Claude (claude-opus-5-5, Anthropic) from the library's urn:magic:dclp:64740:grc, from papyri.info's Digital Corpus of Literary Papyri (CC BY 3.0), one English line for each line of the original. Only some passages are translated so far: those that the Atlas of Ancient Myth, Magic in the Ancient Texts and the demons-and-angels study cite.
header.statement: An AI-generated translation. No specialist has reviewed it.

notes.1: Asterisks are as printed (signs on the amulet). ⟨ ⟩ mark letters supplied by the editor; 'amulet' is broken across lines 8–9 as in the original (φυλ⟨α⟩κτή-ριον). Kale is the wearer's name.

nodes.text: He was raised to judge the living
and the dead. Flee, you too,
now, now, now, quickly, quickly, quickly.
